_meta.title: Decision package: 7-day campaign window forces basic-only program
_meta.why_strong_example: Demonstrates time-constraint discipline. 5 plans → 1 ship + 3 defer-to-next-window + 1 kill. Strategic recommendation explicitly tells operator to pre-commit traffic for the deferred big tests.

input_summary.page_works_summary: baseline=partial (8.5% feels low for the niche); preservation_zones modest (page is not yet deeply optimized). Most levers in the 3-4 range.

shipped_plans.why_this_first: Basic test: replace generic 'Submit' CTA with specific value-prop CTA ('Get My Free Quote'). Page-Works flagged generic CTA as change-safe. Sample size 3500/arm at 8.5% baseline detects ~10% lift — within window. Highest-confidence basic test for short window.

iterate_plans.blocker: Sample size insufficient for window — needs 15,000/arm to detect claimed 6% lift; only 3,500/arm available in 7 days.
what_to_fix: Defer to next month when 14-21 day window is available
Or refocus variant to test a more aggressive headline change with detectable lift floor of 12%+

iterate_plans.blocker: Sample size insufficient — needs 12,000/arm to detect 7% lift.
what_to_fix: Or scope smaller (test ONE field re-order, not full reorder)

iterate_plans.blocker: Sample size adequate but interaction effect with T1 (both above-fold elements). Cannot run parallel with T1; would need a separate window.
what_to_fix: Run after T1 completes (sequential in next 7-day window)
Or test trust badge in a different page section to avoid interaction effect

killed_plans.kill_reason: Super test (paradigm shift from lead-form to quiz funnel) requires 25k+/arm to detect direction-change lifts; impossible in 7-day window with 30k traffic. Even if executed, would need 2-3 week measurement period. Wrong tool for this window.

decision.strategic_recommendation: 7-day window forces conservative testing — only 1 basic test can fit. Ship T1 (CTA specificity) this week. CRITICALLY: pre-commit operator's next 21-day window for T2 (hero rewrite) — it's the highest-leverage deferred test and the page is not deeply optimized yet, so the win potential is real. Do NOT skip the rewrite just because it doesn't fit this campaign.
constraint_warnings: 7-day window is the binding constraint — 4 of 5 plans defer or kill not for quality reasons but for math.
operator should plan a next-month testing block (3 weeks minimum) to harvest the deferred queue.
decision.next_batch_focus: Next 21-day window: T2 (hero rewrite) as primary big-rock test + T3 (form reorder) as parallel-safe basic. T4 (trust badge) deferred until T1's CTA change is measured to avoid above-fold interaction.
